fato_historico: 1896: Philippine Revolution: After Spanish victory in the Battle of San Juan del Monte, eight provinces in the Philippines are declared under martial law by the Spanish Governor-General Ramón Blanco y Erenas.

It is a good time to plant seeds of peace and focus on your inner landscape, where your personal revolution brings forth growth and new opportunities for your soul.
frase_do_dia: True power is found in the quiet elegance of a peaceful heart.
